description: The GLOBAL clause in the linkage section — a COBOL-2002 relaxation of a COBOL-85 restriction, QUOTED from ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 61: "Global clause in the linkage section. The GLOBAL clause may be specified in level 1 data description entries in the linkage section." COBOL-85 is the edition a 2002 Annex F.2 'formerly' statement describes: the owner's decision of 2026-10-31 (kb/Work PB4305) makes the F.2 statements the rule for the 85 edge, as D-SIGN2 (item 124) and PB3683 (item 123) did; GnuCOBOL -std=cobol85 accepts some of them as dialect leniency, which rule 1 places below the ISO text. Gated in ONE place, VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.VisitGlobalClause (kb/Work PB4305; VCR row 7.47).
display: the GLOBAL clause in the linkage section
